correctness.rationale: Uniform positive color-run compositions yield E[X]=(a/p)1, Cov(X)=a(a-p)(pI-J)/(p^2(p+1)), analogously for b and q. Writing inversion U=X^T M Y gives a bilinear variance depending on incidence statistics t,h,j. Even 2r run start orientations mix means ab(r±1)/(2r), adding between-orientation variance, while odd 2r+1 run orientations have equal means and probabilities (a-r)/(a+b-2r),(b-r)/(a+b-2r). Formula (1) and exact positive-numerator difference identities (2)–(5) establish both within-parity decreases and strict odd troughs, with feasibility boundaries a,b>=1. Reversal gives E[U|R]=ab/2. Independent exact Fraction enumeration checked 400 conditional strata for a,b<=8; infinite proof is the displayed symbolic identities and positive-coefficient polynomials.
